disallowed.route: MkDocs derives the page URL from site_url plus the file path; the archived SSG's routing input must not come back
disallowed.canonical: MkDocs emits <link rel=canonical> from site_url plus the file path; a hand-written copy only drifts

notes: lifecycle drives publish gate; completeness is materials readiness. Emoji is display-only. optional_files mixes file names (syllabus.md, review.md) with one directory entry (knowledge/): the directory form means 'the course may ship a knowledge/ subdirectory of generated chapter pages'. No code consumes optional_files; the contract layer reads required_files + page_markers only.
